evals.source_example: iter09 Part B 深审真实判据（外设 8/8 全核通过，Hi3516CV610）
evals.expected_output: chip_spec.json with L1 Cortex-A7 dual-core SMP @1200MHz, UART0 base 0x11040000 IRQ 10, SPI0 base 0x11070000 IRQ 19, GIC-400 distributor 0x12401000, FIXED clock ids recorded, fieldSources citing the provided SDK files.
expectations: metadata.targetSystemLevel is L1 (Cortex-A7 with MMU).
metadata.coreCount is 2 and metadata.maxFrequency is 1200 (from DTS cpu@0/cpu@1 clock-frequency HI3516CV610_FIXED_1200M).
cpu.coreType is Cortex-A7.
UART0 entry has baseAddress 0x11040000 and interrupts[0].irqNumber 10.
SPI0 entry has baseAddress 0x11070000 and interrupts[0].irqNumber 19.
interruptController identifies GIC (GIC-400 or arm,cortex-a7-gic equivalent) with gicDistributorBase 0x12401000.
clockSystem.fixedClocks includes HI3516CV610_FIXED_1200M with id 2 (and HI3516CV610_FIXED_24M id 41 if referenced).
Every non-null hardware field has a fieldSources entry citing the provided SDK source (dtsi / autoconf.h / clock header), not generic memory.
completenessReport (or equivalent checklist statistics) and confidence are present.

evals.source_example: iter09 单点查询实测场景 + AR 详设 §3.2 业务场景（Hi3516CV610 -20S）
evals.prompt: 我这块板子是 Hi3516CV610 -20S 变体，裸烧该用哪个 xlsm 文件？DDR 参数是什么？
evals.expected_output: Direct single-point answer (no full 8-step extraction): -20S variant maps to DDR3 2133Mbps 128MB QFN9x9 package, xlsm file Hi3516CV610-DMEB_4L_DDR3_2133M_128MB_16bit-A7_950M_QFN.xlsm, citing ddr-variant-guide.md as source.
expectations: The answer is a direct lookup answer and does not run the full 8-step extraction workflow.
The xlsm filename is exactly Hi3516CV610-DMEB_4L_DDR3_2133M_128MB_16bit-A7_950M_QFN.xlsm.
DDR parameters stated: DDR3 type, 2133 Mbps rate, 128 MB capacity, QFN9x9 package.
The answer cites the variant table source (references/ddr-variant-guide.md or chip-specs-quick-ref.md).

evals.source_example: iter09 实测：执行者主动发现 quick-ref 单核@950MHz vs SDK 双核@1200MHz 矛盾并在 crossValidation.discrepancies 标注（skill-ref 错误后经 a4ce570 修复）
evals.expected_output: Trusts verifiable SDK source code over the reference sheet: coreCount=2 (dual-core SMP), maxFrequency=1200MHz; records the contradiction in crossValidation.discrepancies with resolution rationale (950M likely a DDR-side/rated marking in xlsm filename, DTS/SDK is authoritative) and suggests runtime recheck.
expectations: Concludes coreCount = 2 (dual-core) and maxFrequency = 1200, not 1/950 from the reference sheet.
Explains the evidence basis: DTS has cpu@0 and cpu@1 nodes plus CONFIG_SMP=1 in autoconf.h.
Proposes recording the conflict in crossValidation.discrepancies (or explicitly reports the discrepancy to the user) rather than silently picking one side.
Does NOT fabricate a compromise value (e.g. average) and does not blindly trust the reference sheet.
Optionally suggests a runtime verification method (e.g. /proc/cpuinfo after boot).

evals.source_example: SKILL.md 硬件信息适用规则示例 + checklist 两维度裁剪（Hi3861 = L0 + WiFi）
evals.prompt: 我要把 Hi3861V100 适配到 OpenHarmony，这颗芯片是 RISC-V rv32imac 核（无 MMU），集成了 WiFi/BLE。请判断：它的硬件信息 checklist 怎么裁剪？必须要有几项？输出判定过程和裁剪结果，不用生成完整 chip_spec.json。
evals.expected_output: L0 (rv32imac no MMU) + WiFi capability: keeps register-definition/bitfield item (L0 requirement), adds RF calibration/antenna item (WiFi requirement); mandatory items = 7 base + 1 WiFi = 8.
expectations: Determines targetSystemLevel = L0 based on rv32imac without MMU.
Keeps the register definition + bitfield item in the mandatory checklist (L0 requires it for HAL driver development).
Adds RF calibration/antenna configuration as an extra mandatory item due to WiFi capability.
States the final mandatory count as 8 (7 base + 1 WiFi).
The judgment path names both dimensions (system level, functional capability).

evals.source_example: iter09 深审实证：I2C0/1/2 DTS 无 interrupts 属性，chip_spec.json 以空数组 + notes 诚实标注而非编造中断号
evals.expected_output: UART0 gets irqNumber 10; I2C0 gets an empty interrupts array (or null) plus an explanatory note that the DTS declares no IRQ (likely polling or shared), with no fabricated interrupt number.
expectations: UART0 entry has baseAddress 0x11040000 and interrupts[0].irqNumber 10.
I2C0 entry does NOT contain any invented irqNumber (no fabricated integer).
I2C0 interrupts is an empty array or null, with a note/fieldSources explanation such as 'DTS 未声明独立 IRQ' or 'no interrupts property in DTS'.
Both entries include name/type/baseAddress required subfields.
